note: Kansas's newest state park, opened August 2026 on a former limestone quarry and cement-plant site just south of Iola. Full-hookup sites with concrete pads on open ground along the top of the quarry wall above 134-acre Lake Lehigh; very little shade. Bathhouse with showers and a visitor center; about 15 miles of hiking and biking trails. The lake is no-wake, best for paddling and electric motors; the boat ramp was not finished in 2026 and the lake bed is sharp stone. --Claude
